name: Famously Fun Performing Arts Workshops – Boo Busters
desc: Our popular theatre workshops return this fall! Each session includes a snack and is packed with crafts, stories, games, and performance fun – from singing and dancing to acting and improvisation. Don’t miss the excitement! Friday, October 30 3:00-4:30pm Hunt Club Park Community Center Save your spot!

name: Learn to Sew Workshop (Ages 14+) – Placemat & Napkin Set
desc: Discover the joy of sewing in this relaxed, project-based workshop led by Loopy Connections, Northern Illinois’ community fiber-arts nonprofit. Learn sewing machine basics while creating a fun, beginner-friendly project to take home. Join once or return to keep building skills and confidence at your own pace! PLACEMAT & NAPKIN SET: Create a pair of coordinating placements and napkins &#8211

name: Natural Christmas Wreaths
desc: The Waukegan Park District is hosting Natural Christmas Wreaths on Friday, December 4, 2026, from 6pm to 7pm at Nature’s Classroom, located at 2255 W. York House Road. Get into the holiday spirit as you create your own natural Christmas wreath using greenery, pine cones, and other seasonal materials. Preregistration is required. For more information, contact Jonathan Cochrane at 847-36
